_doc: Vendor product names on the published site (scripts/site_gates.py vendor-names; COO ruling 2026-10-15, §15.10.761 §4 Sites).
Vendor product names appear on our surfaces only inside ratified strings. A fail-tier name anywhere else fails the build.
Report-tier names are printed on every run, each marked ratified or not, and fail nothing until the COO moves a name to the fail tier.
An allowlist row sanctions the names inside ONE exact ratified string in ONE file; its source names the Copy Set line it comes from.
A row whose string no longer occurs in its file, or that names no listed vendor, fails the build.
The algorithm-protection banned-name step (anthropic, claude, gpt, gemini, openai and the rest) is separate and has no allowlist; names it carries are not repeated here.
any_case names are matched in any case; exact_case names are ordinary words too (cursor, codex, perplexity, llama) and match only as capitalized product names.
robots.txt is excluded: its User-agent tokens are crawler directives, not copy (the same exemption the banned-name step grants).
